reset_rules.notes: Gemini API RPD limits reset at 00:00 Pacific Time (America/Los_Angeles) and apply per GCP project (not per API key). Priority inference defaults to 0.3x standard rate limits. Implicit KV caching requires >= 4,096 base tokens (2,048 on 2.5), and Gemini 4 multi-turn loops require >= 2,050 new tokens per turn to cache the full prior request.

reset_rules_notes_zh: Gemini API 每日请求上限（RPD）按太平洋时间午夜 00:00 PT 重置，且按 GCP 项目（而非 API Key）统计。Priority 推理默认为标准限流的 0.3x。隐式缓存要求前缀 >= 4,096 Token（2.5 为 2,048），Gemini 4 多轮循环还要求每轮新增 >= 2,050 Token 才能完整缓存上一轮请求。

saving_tips.title: Keep Static Prefixes >= 4,096 Tokens & Add >= 2,050 New Tokens on Multi-Turn Loops
saving_tips.title_zh: 保持静态前缀 >= 4,096 Token，多轮循环每轮新增 >= 2,050 Token
saving_tips.impact: Up to 95% implicit cache discount ($0.15 vs $3.00 on Neon) & +28% AGY tasks/quota
saving_tips.impact_zh: 最高享 95% 隐式缓存折扣（Neon $0.15 vs $3.00），AGY 同配额多完成 28% 任务
saving_tips.detail: Official docs confirm Gemini 4 requires >= 4,096 tokens for implicit caching, and multi-turn loops cache the full prior request only when >= 2,050 new tokens are added.
saving_tips.detail_zh: 官方文档确认 Gemini 4 隐式缓存起步门槛为 4,096 Token，且多轮 Agent 循环需新增至少 2,050 Token（含输出/思考/工具结果）才能完整缓存上一轮请求。

saving_tips.title: Use Orchestrator: Neon/Carbon Planner + Hydrogen Executor
saving_tips.title_zh: 启用 Orchestrator：Neon/Carbon 规划 + Hydrogen 执行
saving_tips.detail: Neon is 2x the API cost of Hydrogen ($3/$15 vs $1.50/$7.50) and carries ~2.6x higher bucket weight. Let Neon write the plan, then execute with Hydrogen.
saving_tips.detail_zh: Neon 单价为 Hydrogen 的 2 倍（$3/$15 vs $1.50/$7.50），共享桶权重高约 2.6 倍。让 Neon 一次性产出方案，再交由 Hydrogen 执行。

saving_tips.title: Remember Thinking Tokens Are Billed at Output Rates (5x Input)
saving_tips.title_zh: 牢记 Thinking 思考 Token 按输出单价计费（输入单价的 5 倍）
saving_tips.impact_zh: 降低 30%-60% 输出计费消耗
saving_tips.detail: Official pricing explicitly states 'Output price (including thinking tokens)'. Reserve `high`/`xhigh` for hard architecture and drop to `low` for routine edits.
saving_tips.detail_zh: 官方计价明确标注 Output 价格包含 Thinking Token。仅在架构与疑难排错开启 `high`/`xhigh`，常规编辑降至 `low`。

saving_tips.title: Use Tool Retrieval (defer_loading) for Large MCP Toolsets
saving_tips.title_zh: 大型 MCP 工具集启用 Tool Retrieval（defer_loading）按需加载
saving_tips.impact: Eliminates sending dozens of unused tool schemas on every turn
saving_tips.impact_zh: 避免每轮重复发送数十个闲置工具 Schema
saving_tips.detail: In Interactions API (Gemini 3.6+ / Gemini 4), set `defer_loading: true` with `tool_search` so schemas load only when needed.
saving_tips.detail_zh: 在 Interactions API（支持 Gemini 3.6+ 与 Gemini 4）中配置 `defer_loading: true` 与 `tool_search`，仅在需要时加载工具定义。

saving_tips.title: Run /compact Early & Maintain .geminiignore
saving_tips.impact_zh: 防止上下文雪球式膨胀与 504 超时
saving_tips.detail: Exclude `node_modules/`, lockfiles, and build outputs. Run `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` to audit global rule token bloat.
saving_tips.detail_zh: 屏蔽 `node_modules/`、锁文件与构建目录，并用 `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` 审计全局规则文件体积。
